about: Hand-computed vectors for engine.py (design E1-E12 and the cases around them). A case names the series each timeframe holds (cut for the boundary), the screen's lines, the run's boundary and what the run knows; expect gives the outcome kind and, where listed, the values, reasons, rank and marks. Candle rows are [day, start, minutes, o, h, l, c, v, {oi, atp, flags}]; ladder, pairs and flat expand to rows.
